_comment: 3D sweep: freq_ratio x amp_ratio x phase, k=1 only (other k found not to matter). Both ratios split SYMMETRICALLY around one fixed baseline (center_freq, center_amp) -- moving a ratio away from 1.0 moves both pitch and heave oppositely, not one held fixed. center_freq=0.5Hz / center_amp=0.6283185307rad (40%) chosen because the full ratio grid below stays under the 5.5 rad/s slew ceiling on both servos (worst case ~5.43 rad/s at freq_ratio=2.5 x amp_ratio=0.33) -- see sweep_amp_freq_phase.py --plan-only for the full per-combo check.
